findings.title: Duplicate self-improvement policy configuration formats

evidence.observation: Both JSON and YAML variants of self_improvement_policy exist simultaneously in the config directory
YAML policy file coexists alongside JSON equivalent, risking divergence

proposed_action.description: Standardize on a single policy format (JSON or YAML) and remove the redundant configuration file

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates potential configuration divergence and establishes an unambiguous single source of truth

findings.title: Unrouted models present in local Ollama inventory

evidence.observation: Models qwen3.5:9b, qwen3.5:4b, qwen3.5:2b, and gemma4:12b are pulled and available in Ollama but not referenced in router_status routing_policy

proposed_action.description: Evaluate unassigned models for active task routing assignments or purge them to reclaim disk storage

findings.expected_benefit: Reduces disk resource consumption or incorporates newer model weights into active routing pipelines

findings.title: Virtual environment artifacts included in repository filesystem audits

evidence.observation: Third-party dependency documentation and YAML configurations from core/infrastructure/vm-processing/.venv and platform-runtime/.venv are tracked or traversed in audit scans

proposed_action.description: Update audit scanner exclusion patterns and ensure .venv directories are ignored by repository tooling

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents third-party vendor files from polluting audit metrics, document counts, and configuration discovery
